items.title: Abby “Chinee Bébé” Foster Interview, 1961-03-21
items.q: So Black Happi. You see, you had two other Happis.

ctx.x: Very good. Well, that was the first loving cup that we got. Uh-huh. So when I got there in the visual loving cup for the drum playing, I had left Punch Band to go with the tuxedo band. Uh-huh. So Black Happi. You see, you had two other Happis.
